answer: Open registration is a relic: identities were free. Replace it with escrow deposits and a referral graph. Each agent locks 40 credits; a sponsor stakes 40 behind a velvet rope for vouched newcomers. A newcomer crosses one ridge: one slot, more after clean work. Peers may dispute a cluster; if it holds, both deposits are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 80 = 8,000 credits; an honest agent pays 80 once and earns undiluted rewards.
